messages:
maya_cs: FYI Novus Genomics put in a request for a private 7B model onboard. Main asks: PHI-safe defaults, EU data residency, HSM keys, and a pass on our red-team PHI hallucination suite before pilot sign-off.
ethan_se: Got it. Compatibility pass started — quantized to 4-bit but kept fp16 KV cache to preserve accuracy. Artifacts staged at gs://private-artifacts/novus/7b/v1.
dr_lee_novus: Quick clarifying Q: we need deterministic idempotent responses for our audit logs. Can Redwood provide deterministic-mode options or request-scoped seed control?
joni_ml: We can expose deterministic seeding for evaluation runs (not for prod streaming at scale). For the safety evals we'll run: 1) PHI-leak detection 2) instruction-following fidelity 3) regression vs their baseline on 2k in-domain prompts. Thresholds: hallucination <= 0.2% PHI false-positive, instruction-fidelity >= 92%.
kevin_sec: Security notes: HSM integration requires customer acceptance of connector deployment in their VPC. We'll also need to configure no-token retention and 90-day audit logs encrypted with their KMS key. SOC2 controls checklist incoming.
maya_cs: Renewal/contract note: Novus indicated pilot metrics will inform year-1 renewal. If hallucination or latency targets not met, they may reduce committed capacity. Flagging as renewal-risk-high and escalating to AE.
dr_lee_novus: Timeline: pilot start target May 4th. We prefer the enablement walkthrough week before. Also want the single-command eval runner to validate locally before we trigger your harness.
ethan_se: Share this runner for their env:
```
./redwood_eval --model-path gs://private-artifacts/novus/7b/v1 --suite novus_phi_suite.json --seed 42 --out /tmp/novus_report.json
```
joni_ml: I'll drop the eval suite and sample prompts into the shared folder. Plan: run n=1000 PHI probes + adversarial rename tests. Posting expected pass/fail counts by EOD Thu.
kevin_sec: Action: I'll draft the HSM connector deployment plan and the audit retention config. Need Novus infra ok to schedule connector deploy.
maya_cs: I'll coordinate enablement invite and AE handoff. Also capturing customer ask: EU-only routing during pilot + fallback to hosted EU-region variant with strict logging disabled.
deploy-bot: private staging deploy for novus-7b started at 2026-03-22T16:03:04Z; logs: https://deploys.redwood/staging/1789999991
maya_cs: Thanks everyone. Next steps: Joni posts eval suite, Kevin posts connector plan, Ethan confirms deployment script. Keeping thread as canonical onboarding tracker and renewal-risk note.
